requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Concern-mixing detected. Decomposed into one functional requirement (inform security service) and one quality requirement (2-second response time constraint) per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: When the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action. The timing constraint was separated into a quality requirement.

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds of the glass break detector detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted the timing constraint as a separate quality requirement, linking it back to the triggering event.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the exact mechanism of 'informing' (e.g., call, message) or the state of the detector itself, as these were not detailed.
